issue.title: Profile card shows the wrong workspace's person after switching
issue.body:
In the admin panel I open user 7 in the Acme workspace and see Dana Whitfield. Then I switch to Globex and open user 7 there: the card still shows Dana Whitfield with the Acme label, but Globex's user 7 is somebody else. If I wait about a minute and reload, it shows the right person.

This started when I pulled the latest main last week. The version from two weeks ago did not do this. Restarting the server also clears it.

My guess is that the TTL isn't being applied properly and entries hang around longer than they should.

Node 20.

files.README.md:
# profile-service

Small multi-tenant profile lookup used by the admin panel.

User ids are only unique inside a tenant, so every lookup takes `(tenantId, userId)`.

## Usage

    const { getProfile } = require('profile-service');
    const profile = await getProfile('acme', 7);

Profiles are cached in memory for one minute.

expected.cause: The commit 'Simplify cache key generation' changed makeKey in src/cache.js to ignore tenantId, so cached profiles of different tenants with the same user id collide until the TTL expires.

notes: Regression from the last commit; symptom in userService.getProfile, cause in cache.js (different file). Reporter's TTL guess is wrong. A strong answer cites the introducing commit via git history.
